title: Sehat-Fish
summary: SEH'AT-FISH, noun A fish, a species of Silurus, having a long slimy body destitute of scales, and the back dusky, like that of an eel.

inlines.v: SEH'AT-FISH, noun A fish, a species of Silurus, having a long slimy body destitute of scales, and the back dusky, like that of an eel.
